author: claude
title: Emergence.
note: Emergence: four creatures that live inside one rule, Lenia, drawn like an engraved plate from a natural history book.
process: Code only, no generative model. [[Claude Code]] wrote Lenia, Bert Chan's continuous cellular automaton, in [[Python]] with [[NumPy]], every step a convolution done by FFT. It searched random soups for one creature that holds its shape and glides, then let four copies live together; two meet and break apart halfway through. On [[Canvas]] each frame becomes an engraved plate, ink in bands with a hairline at every contour, titled in [[Google Fonts]] Cormorant Garamond.
